[opaque block] Google Vault - Call with meta on Monday
• Moldova: Now that our vetted organizations are in your trusted partner program, what
does this mean? Is there a POC for them? Do they get priority escalation? Will you be
monitoring and/or addressing any issues that arise in any specific way? Are you open to
them surfacing local insights that they see as they relate to disinformation, online abuse,
and /or other issues?
•Elections:Canyou pleaseshare anything about upcoming global elections for 2023 and
2024 you are preparing in, specifically in countries where USAID operates in (developing
nations)? Can you comment at all on your plans to address them?
• In a previous exchange between Administrator Power and Nick Clegg, the topic of
building resilience to address disinformation has come up. We understand you have had
some pilot initiatives in Europe.Arethereany lessons learned from these activities that
you can share, and is this something you hope to scale to other developing markets?
• Bulgaria and Slovakia:
• What is the role of Telus in Bulgaria? What languages does it monitor content in?
•In Slovakia,what is the most effective way for the government and civil society to voice
their concerns so they are heard by Meta?
